definitions.explanation: The week before this one; the previous week. Used to refer to events or states in the week that just passed.

examples.japanese: {先週|せんしゅう}{映画|えいが}を{見|み}ました。
examples.english: I watched a movie last week.

examples.japanese: {先週|せんしゅう}の{金曜日|きんようび}に{友達|ともだち}と{会|あ}いました。
examples.english: I met with a friend last Friday.

examples.japanese: {先週|せんしゅう}は{雨|あめ}が{多|おお}かったです。
examples.english: There was a lot of rain last week.

examples.japanese: {先週|せんしゅう}{日本|にほん}に{行|い}きました。とても{楽|たの}しかったです。
examples.english: I went to Japan last week. It was a lot of fun.

examples.japanese: {先週|せんしゅう}から{毎日|まいにち}{勉強|べんきょう}しています。{日本語|にほんご}が{上手|じょうず}になりたいです。
examples.english: I've been studying every day since last week. I want to get good at Japanese.

notes: Part of a time reference series: {先週|せんしゅう} (last week), {今週|こんしゅう} (this week), {来週|らいしゅう} (next week). The {先|せん} prefix means 'previous' or 'before' and also appears in {先月|せんげつ} (last month).
